claude_news.title: Anthropic Opens Seoul Office and Announces Korean AI Partnerships
claude_news.summary: Anthropic officially opened its Seoul office on June 17, 2026, establishing a formal presence in South Korea. The company announced several new partnerships across the Korean AI ecosystem alongside the opening. The expansion reflects Anthropic's broader push into Asia-Pacific markets amid growing enterprise demand for Claude.
claude_news.relevance: Anthropic's Seoul expansion signals accelerating international growth and new regional availability of Claude for Korean enterprise customers.

claude_news.title: US Orders Anthropic to Disable Fable and Mythos AI Models for All Foreign Nationals
claude_news.summary: The US Commerce Department invoked export control powers on national security grounds to bar Anthropic from distributing its newest Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models to any foreign national. Anthropic suspended access to both models on June 12–13 shortly after the directive, affecting users outside the United States. The company subsequently filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration, arguing the underlying statute does not legally support the supply chain risk designation applied to its models.
claude_news.relevance: Users outside the US lost access to Anthropic's two most powerful models, signalling that geopolitics now directly shapes which Claude capabilities are available globally.

claude_news.title: US Orders Anthropic to Disable AI Models for All Foreign Nationals
claude_news.summary: Al Jazeera reported that the US government directed Anthropic to cut off all foreign nationals from its most advanced Claude models, framing it as a national security measure. The move is one of the most sweeping AI export restrictions applied to a private AI lab to date. The order drew international criticism and raised concerns about the growing use of export controls to limit access to frontier AI.
claude_news.relevance: Marks a significant escalation in US AI export policy, with direct implications for international Claude users and the global AI competitive landscape.

claude_news.title: Claude Adds Managed Agents with Cron Scheduling and Vault-Stored Credentials
claude_news.summary: Anthropic launched a public beta for Managed Agents, enabling Claude agents to run automatically on cron schedules while securely using CLI tools and authenticated external services. Credentials are stored in a vault, and agents can leverage browser-capable integrations. This brings persistent, autonomous task automation natively into the Claude platform.
claude_news.relevance: Developers can now run fully automated, scheduled Claude agent workflows without managing their own infrastructure, lowering the barrier to production agentic applications.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Launches Enterprise MCP Connector Access via Okta Integration
claude_news.summary: Anthropic introduced enterprise-managed MCP connector access, starting with an Okta integration that lets admins provision connectors once across their organization. Employees receive zero-touch access to approved MCP connectors on their first login, eliminating per-user setup. The feature is aimed at regulated industries where centralized access control is a requirement.
claude_news.relevance: Enterprise IT teams can now centrally govern which Claude integrations employees can access, making large-scale Claude deployments significantly easier to manage and audit.
